steps: 步骤1：点击左侧导航栏 "Vehicle"  > Driving assistance > Comfort
步骤2：开启/关闭"Following distance", "Display risky areas", "Adaptive speed limiter and cruise control"3个选项
expected: 步骤1：页面显示"Eco predictive assistant", "Following distance", "Display risky areas", "Adaptive speed limiter and cruise control" 和 "To road context"
步骤2：3个选项成功开启/关闭，动画成功显示
postcondition: 杀死所有进程，车机恢复初始状态
